title: Welcome to the KShop: Your Holiday Gift Guide, Demon-Hunters Approved
summary: With Megan Thee Stallion behind the counter and Charles Melton and Michael Irvin shopping the shelves, the KShop has every 'KPop Demon Hunters' gift on your list.
body_markdown:
Gift buyers, brace yourselves. You have a new demon to face this holiday — finding the perfect


[KPop Demon Hunters](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/kpop-demon-hunters) gift.


Lucky for you,


[Netflix’s KShop](https://www.instagram.com/kshopdemonhunters/) is now open, and it’s the official home base for all things


KPop Demon Hunters


. Three-time Grammy Award-winning superstar and


[Roommates](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/roommates) actress Megan Thee Stallion is running the register as the ultimate shopkeeper — a natural fit for the avid K-pop and anime fan. Emmy-nominated


[BEEF](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/beef) star Charles Melton and NFL Hall of Famer (and


[The White House](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/white-house-with-michael-irvin-podcast) host) Michael Irvin both wander in hunting for the hottest drops, and let’s just say nobody’s leaving without a bag.


Charles Melton at the KShop. (Credit: Netflix Brand Creative Studio)


Michael Irvin at the KShop. (Credit: Netflix Brand Creative Studio)


Inside, the shelves are stacked with what fans are hoping to unwrap this year, from collectible


[Kayou trading cards](https://www.kayouofficial.com/en-US/series/series-udf0eb3v) to


[Mattel singing dolls](https://shop.mattel.com/products/kpop-demon-hunters-huntrx-rumi-golden-singing-doll-jrn40) to


[Hasbro](http://google.com/url?q=https://www.walmart.com/ip/KPop-Demon-Hunters-HUNTR-X-Light-Stick-Electronic-Toy-with-Light-FX-Ages-6-and-up/19424554900&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1795032516433154&usg=AOvVaw1FHRvSM_P-QxkfHtsgCJRA)[l](http://google.com/url?q=https://www.walmart.com/ip/KPop-Demon-Hunters-HUNTR-X-Light-Stick-Electronic-Toy-with-Light-FX-Ages-6-and-up/19424554900&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1795032516433154&usg=AOvVaw1FHRvSM_P-QxkfHtsgCJRA)[ight](http://google.com/url?q=https://www.walmart.com/ip/KPop-Demon-Hunters-HUNTR-X-Light-Stick-Electronic-Toy-with-Light-FX-Ages-6-and-up/19424554900&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1795032516433154&usg=AOvVaw1FHRvSM_P-QxkfHtsgCJRA)[s](http://google.com/url?q=https://www.walmart.com/ip/KPop-Demon-Hunters-HUNTR-X-Light-Stick-Electronic-Toy-with-Light-FX-Ages-6-and-up/19424554900&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1795032516433154&usg=AOvVaw1FHRvSM_P-QxkfHtsgCJRA)[ticks](http://google.com/url?q=https://www.walmart.com/ip/KPop-Demon-Hunters-HUNTR-X-Light-Stick-Electronic-Toy-with-Light-FX-Ages-6-and-up/19424554900&sa=D&source=docs&ust=1795032516433154&usg=AOvVaw1FHRvSM_P-QxkfHtsgCJRA) and the


[LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird set](https://www.lego.com/en-us/product/derpy-tiger-and-sussie-bird-72537?age-gate=grown_up) . And of course, a few hidden merchandise surprises are tucked in there too, for anyone who looks closely.


Take a Look Around the KShop


Three mini-episodes are live now on the


[KShopDemonHunters](https://www.instagram.com/kshopdemonhunters/) Instagram channel, each one a chance to spot your next gift:


-


“The Shadow”


(featuring Melton, with LEGO and Hasbro toys): Things get out of hand during Megan’s shift. Even demons (and Melton) can’t resist the LEGO Derpy Tiger and Sussie Bird set.


-


“The Playmaker”


(featuring Irvin, with Kayou trading cards): Hunters never fumble an opportunity to collect a Kayou Energy Edition Series 2 Rumi card. Michael, it’s your time to shine.


-


“The Matriarch”


: We do NOT play about the Rumi “Golden” singing doll.


All three of these mini-episodes created by Netflix’s Brand Creative Studio are just a tease of what to expect from the official spot debuting Wednesday during the NFL’s first-ever


[Thanksgiving Eve game](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/features/nfl-thanksgiving-eve-game-2026-how-to-watch) . Airing on Netflix at 8pm ET/5pm PT, the game will feature the Green Bay Packers facing off against the Los Angeles Rams at SoFi Stadium. In addition to the star-studded KShop ad, look out for a special


[halftime performance](https://www.netflix.com/tudum/articles/nfl-thanksgiving-eve-game-2026-halftime-u2) from 22-time Grammy Award winners and Rock and Roll Hall of Famers U2, celebrating their 50th anniversary as a band.


Tune in for the official spot and get your KShop gift lists ready.
